name: The Tied Observations
method: Installed built-in image generator supplied the motif; Node built-ins removed white in memory and composited pigment only in vacant rock. Generated motif overwritten by final wall.
visual_review: Inspected full PNG and decoded 512px JPEG. Three tied pebbles in red/yellow ochre and charcoal occupy previously vacant left rock. Existing paintings, rock, cracks, torchlight and framing remain unchanged outside the addition. Pepe retains his wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes. No writing, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, people or prohibited symbols observed.
hands: Counted inherited Pepe hands as four fingers and one thumb each, five digits. The inherited lower-left stencil also has four fingers and one thumb. No new hand or stencil was added; all inherited hands remain pixel-identical.
limitations: Local visual review only. The inherited rock looks photographic and is preserved as required. The small mark is subdued at thumbnail scale; the JPEG is lossy.
